nodes.label: App Icon (icon.svg)
nodes.description: 512x512 rounded-square app icon: a stacked mahjong tile on a green felt radial-gradient background, showing the red dragon character 中.
nodes.rationale: Rounded 112px corners match platform app-icon masks; green felt evokes a mahjong table.

nodes.label: Green Felt Radial Gradient Background
nodes.rationale: Radial gradient (#22865d to #08301f) lit from upper center to suggest a table-felt surface with depth.

nodes.label: Red Dragon 中 Glyph (shape-drawn)
nodes.rationale: Drawn as a stroked rectangle plus vertical bar in #c0262d so it needs no font (renders consistently without CJK font availability).

nodes.label: Stacked Mahjong Tile Group
nodes.rationale: Three offset rounded rects (dark green shadow, green back, ivory face gradient) create a 3D tile with a classic green-backed mahjong tile look.

nodes.label: Maskable App Icon (icon-maskable.svg)
nodes.rationale: Full-bleed 512x512 green felt radial-gradient background so the OS mask can crop to any shape; tile group scaled to 0.72 and centered to stay inside the maskable safe zone.

nodes.label: Ivory Mahjong Tile Glyph
nodes.rationale: Three stacked offset rounded rects (dark green, green back, ivory gradient face) give a 3D tile with visible green backing, like a real mahjong tile.

nodes.label: Red Dragon (中) Drawn as Shapes
nodes.rationale: The 中 character is built from a stroked rounded rect plus a vertical bar so the icon needs no font and renders identically everywhere.

nodes.label: Green Felt Table Visual Theme
nodes.rationale: Dark green gradient background mimics a game table felt, likely shared with the app's overall color scheme.

nodes.label: Red Dragon (中) Tile Motif
nodes.rationale: The Red Dragon is one of the most iconic mahjong honor tiles, making it a recognizable brand mark for the game.

nodes.label: Apple Touch Icon (Red Dragon Mahjong Tile)
nodes.norm_label: apple touch icon (red dragon mahjong tile)
nodes.rationale: iOS home-screen icon: a single ivory mahjong tile bearing the red 中 (Red Dragon / Zhong) character, centered on a dark green felt-style radial background with a soft drop shadow; evokes a mahjong table and gives instant game recognition at small size.

nodes.label: App Icon 192px (Red Dragon Mahjong Tile)
nodes.rationale: 192x192 PWA/home-screen app icon. Depicts a single ivory mahjong tile bearing the red 中 (Red Dragon / zhong) character on a dark green felt-like rounded-square background, evoking a mahjong table. The Red Dragon is the most iconic, instantly recognizable mahjong tile, giving strong brand identity at small sizes.

nodes.label: App Icon 512px (Red Dragon Mahjong Tile)
nodes.rationale: 512x512 app icon (likely PWA manifest / splash size). Depicts a single ivory mahjong tile bearing the red 中 (Zhong, Red Dragon) character on a rounded-square felt-green gradient background, with a green tile backing visible behind it to suggest 3D depth. The Red Dragon is the most iconic, instantly recognizable mahjong tile; green evokes a mahjong table felt; flat, high-contrast design reads well at small sizes.

nodes.label: Maskable App Icon 512px
nodes.description: 512x512 PWA maskable icon: a single ivory mahjong tile with a red 'zhong' (中) character, the Red Dragon tile, on a full-bleed radial felt-green background with a darker green tile edge shadow.
nodes.rationale: The tile is shrunk to roughly the central 30% of the canvas and the green background bleeds to all edges so that any OS mask shape (circle, squircle, rounded square) cropping to the ~80% safe zone never clips the tile or leaves transparent corners.

nodes.label: Felt Green Table Theme
nodes.description: Dark green radial gradient evoking a mahjong table felt; likely matches the app's theme/background color.

nodes.label: Red Dragon Tile (中) Motif
nodes.description: Mahjong Red Dragon (Zhong) tile used as the app's brand mark: cream tile face, red 中 glyph, green 3D edge.

nodes.label: Maskable Icon Safe Zone
nodes.description: PWA maskable icon design constraint: essential content kept within the central circle (radius 40%) with full-bleed background.

nodes.label: Favicon 32px (Red Dragon Tile Icon)
nodes.rationale: 32x32 browser-tab favicon depicting a mahjong tile: dark green rounded-square background with an ivory/white tile face bearing a red 中 (Zhong, Red Dragon) character. The Red Dragon is the most recognizable mahjong tile, making it an iconic, legible brand mark at tiny sizes; green background evokes the felt table and the classic tile back color.

nodes.label: Test & deploy to GitHub Pages workflow
nodes.norm_label: test & deploy to github pages workflow

nodes.label: Stamp service worker version (commit SHA)
nodes.rationale: A new VERSION string changes sw.js, so browsers install the update and drop the previous deploy's caches.

nodes.label: Subsetted Noto Serif SC font
nodes.rationale: Only the CJK glyphs used on tiles are requested, so the font stays tiny.

nodes.label: No dependencies / no build step
nodes.rationale: Plain ES modules with no deps or build so GitHub Pages can serve the repo as is.

nodes.label: Shared-origin safety
nodes.rationale: GitHub Pages serves all of a user's projects from one origin; caches, localStorage and service workers are per origin, so the app namespaces everything with a unique id and scopes the SW to the repo folder.

nodes.label: Solvable deal generation (reverse play)
nodes.rationale: Generator plays the layout backwards, removing random pairs of free slots and assigning matching faces, guaranteeing every deal and shuffle is winnable.

nodes.label: Stale-while-revalidate caching
nodes.rationale: When deploying from a branch without SHA stamping, returning visitors still get updates one load late.

nodes.label: Free vs Blocked Tile Highlighting
nodes.rationale: Design decision: dim blocked tiles so players can instantly see which tiles are selectable.

nodes.label: Narrow (Phone) Gameplay Screenshot
nodes.rationale: Portrait 720x1280 screenshot of an in-progress Mahjong Solitaire game (not an install dialog itself); 'narrow' form factor screenshot typically referenced by the PWA manifest screenshots[] for the richer install UI on mobile.

nodes.rationale: Branding with green 'red dragon' (中) app icon and a named/numbered layout ('Garden #8') suggesting seeded or numbered deals.
